# D14 — clones labelled at day 14, analysed at day 28

```{r h9-D14}

df <- read_csv("/Users/boeziog/Desktop/H9_D14-D28_clonal_counts_fixed.csv")

long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Experiment, Well),
    names_to = c("clone", "marker"),
    names_pattern = "(clone\\d+)_(.*)",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = marker, values_from = value)

clone_counts_D14 <- long %>%
  mutate(
    denom = `488-pax2` + `647-lmx1b`,
    ratio = if_else(denom == 0 | is.na(denom), NA_real_, `488-pax2` / denom)
  ) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(denom) | denom == 0)) %>%
  select(Experiment, Well, clone, `647-lmx1b`, `488-pax2`, ratio)

# Summary counts
cat("Total clones:", nrow(clone_counts_D14), "\n")
cat("Total wells:", n_distinct(paste(clone_counts_D14$Experiment, clone_counts_D14$Well)), "\n")
clone_counts_D14 %>% count(Experiment, name = "clones") %>% print()

# Density + KDE plot
ggplot(clone_counts_D14, aes(x = ratio)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..),
                 binwidth = 0.1,
                 fill = "lightgray",
                 color = "black",
                 alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_density(fill = "cornflowerblue", alpha = 0.4, color = NA) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Fraction dI4 / (dI4 + dI5) in clones",
    y = "Density"
  )

ggsave(filename = "H9-RFP-D14-28-dI4_dI5_density.pdf", plot = last_plot(), path = plots,
       scale = 1, width = 16, height = 12, units = "cm", dpi = 300, bg = "transparent")

# Count plot
ggplot(clone_counts_D14, aes(x = ratio)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1,
                 fill = "lightgray",
                 color = "black") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Fraction dI4 / (dI4 + dI5) in clones",
    y = "Count"
  )

ggsave(filename = "H9-RFP-D14-28-dI4_dI5_counts.pdf", plot = last_plot(), path = plots,
       scale = 1, width = 16, height = 12, units = "cm", dpi = 300, bg = "transparent")
```
